progress.comment: can, we make it a mix between 7 and 10, where we keep the looks of 7, but print the value in the yellow tip. And maybe make 3 variations on it, with slightly slower speeds
progress.reply: Seven was Ruled and ten was Labelled. The first option is the mix: Ruled's track and fill with its ticks, and the yellow tip prints the value in ink at weight 800, counting up in the same ten hard steps as the share arrives (busy prints three dots). Three variations follow with only the speed changed, every one keeping its ten steps with each step longer: a little slower (1.25x, 1500 ms loop), slower (1.5x, 1800 ms) and a lot slower (2x, 2400 ms). The ten earlier bars are gone from the list.
